finding: `atm next` readiness guidance can recommend `node atm.mjs taskflow diagnose --task <task-id> --json`, but the exposed `taskflow` command surface has only open, close, and pre-close; `diagnose` is not executable. Operators are routed to a nonexistent lifecycle recovery command.
expectedBehavior: Every `requiredCommand` or readiness command emitted by `next` must be accepted by the frozen CLI and covered by a command-spec integration test. Either implement `taskflow diagnose` as the canonical read-only lifecycle diagnostic or emit an existing supported command such as the appropriate tasks reconciliation/status route.
evidenceOrRepro: During ATM-GOV-0266 recovery, `taskflow --help` exposed only open/close/pre-close while `next --json` emitted a `reconcile-required` state whose next action was `node atm.mjs taskflow diagnose --task <task-id> --json`.
followUp: Add a CLI contract regression that enumerates all commands emitted by `next` and verifies they resolve in the frozen runner. Repair the lifecycle diagnostic route and add a read-only taskflow diagnose fixture if that is the intended public API.
